title: Two players aiming
description: A split fight, Gerard on player 1 and Aitor (Tecnópata) on player 2's controller: each player's aim shows in their own colour, Gerard's gold and Aitor's cyan, on the foe's plate, on the ring on the floor, on the party card a cure is aimed at and on the name in their target picker. On the same foe the two rings stack, Aitor's as a cyan rim round Gerard's gold; while Aitor aims a cure, Gerard's foes stay pickable. Two standard gamepads are faked in the page.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads;

steps.caption: Gerard aims Atacar: gold on the plate, the ring on the floor and his picker's name
Aitor aims at the same foe: his cyan rim round Gerard's gold ring, both colours on the plate
Each on their own foe: gold for Gerard, cyan for Aitor, each picker naming theirs in their colour

steps.eval: (() => { const ui = window.gerard.battleUI; ui.control('cancel', 2); ui.control('down', 2); ui.control('confirm', 2); for (let i = 0; i < 12 && !/sanaci/i.test(document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="2"] .is-cursor-2')?.textContent ?? ''); i++) ui.control('down', 2); ui.control('confirm', 2); })()

steps.caption: Aitor aims Rayo de sanación at a party card: it lights up in cyan, while Gerard's foe stays aimed in gold
Player 2's pad walks the cure to the other card
